answers.1a: Traditional n-grams have limited context window (n-1 tokens) and cannot capture long-range semantic dependencies due to exponential parameter growth.
answers.1b: Self-attention in transformers is permutation invariant with no inherent order. Positional encodings PE(pos, 2i)=sin(pos/10000^(2i/d_model)) are added to inject sequential position.
answers.1c: Encoder-only models (BERT) use bidirectional attention for classification/encoding; decoder-only models (GPT) use causal masked attention for autoregressive text generation.
answers.1d: Masked attention sets future token weights to -infinity before softmax to prevent information leakage during next-token prediction.

answers.3b: Top-2 decoding selects Word C and Word D with k=2.
answers.3c: Layer normalization is applied twice: after self-attention and after feed forward network to normalize inputs and outputs and stabilize gradients.
